programs.title: General Guan Yu Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary is a unique exploration of the late Eastern Han dynasty general Guan Yu. Through a gaming team's recreation of the Battle of Xiangfan, overseas collections of his porcelain sculptures, and a coming-of-age ceremony at Guandi temple, this episode recounts his military achievements, while describing a man of loyalty, righteousness, courage, and honor-and an enduring spiritual symbol for the Chinese people.

programs.title: One Photographer's China Journey Ep.3
programs.desc: Through eyes and lenses of a French photographer, this documentary takes us on a journey that captures China’s post-reform transformation and the role that this is playing in the country’s ongoing national rejuvenation.

programs.title: Joyous Occasions Ep.1
programs.desc: Authentic and heartwarming modern-day stories intertwine with traditional Chinese wedding customs, as dialects, costumes, music, and intangible cultural heritage are brought to life through the wedding rituals of the nation's ethnic minority communities.

programs.title: Joyous Occasions Ep.2
programs.desc: Authentic and heartwarming modern-day stories intertwine with traditional Chinese wedding customs, as dialects, costumes, music, and intangible cultural heritage are brought to life through the wedding rituals of the nation's ethnic minority communities.

programs.title: Fearless Journey Ep.5
programs.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programs.title: The Great Wall Ep.6
programs.desc: From a fresh perspective, the codes of Chinese civilization and the spirit of a nation emerge amid the sweeping grandeur of the Great Wall National Cultural Park.

programs.title: Exploring Ethnic Attire: Dong Elegance
programs.desc: Dong clothing weaves together tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique identity of the Dong ethnic group. In this episode, we'll unravel the stories behind the intricate designs, vibrant colors, and deep cultural significance of Dong attire. From ceremonial garments to everyday wear, each piece is imbued with the essence of a rich heritage.

programs.title: Razor: Traces of China Ep.1
programs.desc: Chinese elements can be found in many great European mansions, gardens and other public spaces. Join us as we look into these hidden features, motifs and designs and uncover a legacy of East-West cultural exchange that is all too often overlooked!

programs.title: Gently Down the Stream
programs.desc: She joined the Communist Party of Great Britain, took part in China's land reform, and stayed on this red soil when she could have left. At 105, Isabel Crook, recipient of the Friendship Medal of the People's Republic of China, is portrayed in a poetic, narration-free film.
